set.academic_threshold: Arts: three A-Levels in different subjects (no specific subjects required); typical range AAA to ABB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
IB: no specific subjects required; typical range 33 to 36 subject points (out of 42, excluding core). Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

McGill lists requirements by country on its admissions site. In A-Level terms: Arts: three A-Levels in different subjects (no specific subjects required); typical range AAA to ABB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

B+ average (unweighted) in each of grades 11 and 12, with B+ in English. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027 (typical submitted: ACT 27-29 or SAT Reading & Writing 670-700). Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
Management: three A-Levels including Maths; typical range A*AA to AAB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
IB: HL Maths (AA or AI) or SL Maths AA at 6-7; typical range 35 to 38 subject points (out of 42), with Maths 5 at HL or 6 at SL. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
McGill lists requirements by country on its admissions site. In A-Level terms: Management: three A-Levels including Maths; typical range A*AA to AAB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

B+ to A- average in grades 11 and 12, with B+ in maths and A- in English; pre-calculus required. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027 (typical submitted: ACT 29-31 or SAT 690-700 / Math 690-710). Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
Mechanical Engineering: three A-Levels including at least two of Maths, Chemistry, Physics; typical range A*A*A to AAA. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

IB: Maths, Chemistry and Physics (at least one at HL); Mechanical Engineering typical range 38 to 42 subject points (out of 42), with 6 in each maths and science. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

McGill lists requirements by country on its admissions site. In A-Level terms: Mechanical Engineering: three A-Levels including at least two of Maths, Chemistry, Physics; typical range A*A*A to AAA. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
A- to A average in grades 11 and 12 (varies by engineering programme), with pre-calculus, chemistry and physics. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
Science: three A-Levels including Maths and one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics; Computer Sciences group typical range A*AA to ABB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

IB: Maths and two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics (one maths/science at HL); typical range 35 to 38 subject points (out of 42), each maths and science 5-6 with at least one 6. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

McGill lists requirements by country on its admissions site. In A-Level terms: Science: three A-Levels including Maths and one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics; Computer Sciences group typical range A*AA to ABB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

B+ to A- average in grades 11 and 12, with A- in each prerequisite maths and science. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027 (typical submitted: ACT 29-31 or SAT 690-700 / Math 690-710). Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
